rio-de-janeiro.name: Copacabana Beach
rio-de-janeiro.summary: Rio's famous 4 km crescent of sand below the wave-patterned promenade, backed by Avenida Atlântica's hotels and kiosks.
rio-de-janeiro.expect: Lively all day with vendors, beach football and volleyball; keep valuables to a minimum on the sand.
rio-de-janeiro.tip: Walk or cycle the promenade from Leme to Forte de Copacabana in the late afternoon, then go on to Arpoador for sunset.
rio-de-janeiro.why: Burle Marx's black-and-white wave pavement and the beach itself are the picture most people have of Rio.
flow: Start at Leme at the northern end.
Walk the promenade past the Copacabana Palace.
End at Forte de Copacabana for the view back along the bay.
rio-de-janeiro.bestFor: Beach days and a promenade walk
